recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with a dark bouffant hairstyle, framed by out-of-focus pink blossom branches. The composition uses a high-key, slightly desaturated color palette with a strong emphasis on lavender and lilac tones, featuring a left-aligned typographic block and a technical header bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground blossoms create a shallow depth of field, framing the central subject.
The purple knit sweater harmonizes with the lavender-toned display typography.
The technical header bar provides a geometric contrast to the organic floral elements.
Left-aligned text blocks balance the right-weighted visual weight of the subject's pose.
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field with foreground bokeh

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, medium shot, looking towards the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark hair provide the primary visual anchor against the light background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top-left typography, moves down the text list, and settles on the subject's face framed by blossoms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper left and top center to accommodate text and technical headers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and lavender for primary text and knitwear.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink for the blossoms and coral-red for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), creating a nostalgic, airy feel.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features high x-height and open counters.
Body text uses a condensed, all-caps sans-serif for list items.
Header text uses an extended, wide-track sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' in the display title has a wide, overlapping stroke appearance.
The 'a' in the display title is a single-story geometric form.

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned to the left of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, airy geometric sans-serif paired with a tight, condensed all-caps sans-serif for functional lists.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines in the header
Double-ended arrow icon in the header

avoid: Centered text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, high x-height look of the display title.
Matches the utilitarian, condensed feel of the tracklist.
Similar to the wide, technical header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with 1960s bouffant hair wearing a purple knit sweater, framed by out-of-focus pink cherry blossom branches against a cream background. High-key lighting, vintage film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin horizontal line across the top. Place large lavender geometric sans-serif text in the top left. Below it, add a vertical list of all-caps condensed sans-serif text in lavender, right-aligned relative to a vertical axis on the left side of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the tracklist all-caps and condensed?
Is the subject framed by out-of-focus blossoms?
Is there a technical header bar at the very top?

adjustableVariables: Shade of purple in the knitwear and text
Width of the top header bar
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Catalog numbers in the top right corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the blossoms appear in both the foreground and background for depth.
Verify the header bar is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the color of the text matches the sweater.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus floral portrait with a left-aligned geometric sans-serif layout and a technical header bar to evoke 1960s pop/country album aesthetics.
